title: Lasted less than 2 years
text:
Lasted less than 2 years. We bought this toaster from Target a while after we moved here, which was two years ago. About a month or two ago stopped wanting to toast at all--as in, when you push down the lever, it doesn't stay down. It acts like it isn't plugged in. It certainly isn't the outlet's problem because we tried plenty of those.
So I paid 40 dollars for a toaster that lasted less than two years. If I had the receipt, I could get a replacement or something since there's a two-year warranty, but who the hell keeps a receipt for a toaster for two years? We had a crappy $10 toaster from Walmart before this one, and it lasted probably six years before we upgraded to this [supposedly better] new one (as in, it hadn't even stopped working yet). You'd think a 40 dollar toaster would last a long time and toast bread better than a cheap Walmart toaster. You'd think.

The only reason I'm giving it two stars is because for a year and a half it DID work exactly like it was supposed to. I certainly won't be buying another Black & Decker toaster again!
